data_quality.issue: Two sellable SKUs have no PO landed-cost history
data_quality.resolution: Imputed each SKU at its brand median landed unit cost and flagged every affected row.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Quarantine cost-missing SKUs; require finance approval before publishing final CM.

data_quality.issue: PH-DENTAL-30CT PO quantity is cases, not sellable units
data_quality.evidence: Description says CASE OF 12; 99 PO cases become 1,188 sellable units.
data_quality.resolution: Applied an explicit 12-unit case-pack override before calculating weighted landed cost.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Maintain effective-dated UOM conversion rules in a product/UOM bridge.

data_quality.issue: One product appears under two SKU strings
data_quality.evidence: PF-ELECTRO-CITRUS aliases PF-ELECTRO-CIT; 53 affected source rows.
data_quality.resolution: Canonicalized using an auditable alias bridge; matched ASIN B0PFELECIT.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Never update facts in place; resolve identifiers through an effective-dated bridge.

data_quality.issue: ASIN is not unique in the supplied mapping
data_quality.evidence: 2 mapping rows share duplicate ASIN values; B0GTRLRJDE spans two brands.
data_quality.resolution: Used SKU as the transaction join key and quarantined ASIN-only joins for review.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Test uniqueness by marketplace + ASIN + effective date; retain exceptions table.

data_quality.issue: Platform fees and adjustments have no usable SKU allocation key
data_quality.evidence: 9 settlement rows lack SKU, including advertising, storage, and subscription fees.
data_quality.resolution: Kept these amounts below SKU-attributable CM1; did not force an allocation.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Ingest advertising campaign/product reports and storage SKU detail before allocation.

data_quality.issue: PO data has no receipt/status lifecycle
data_quality.evidence: PO date and inbound snapshot cannot prove whether a PO is open, shipped, received, or canceled.
data_quality.resolution: Used PO lines only for weighted landed unit cost; did not label PO quantities as inbound.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Add PO header/status, expected ship/arrival, receipt, and Amazon shipment IDs.

data_quality.evidence: 0 failed parses after normalized mixed-format parsing.
data_quality.resolution: Parsed with mixed-format logic and stored as typed dates.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Reject unparseable dates in staging and publish source-row error counts.

data_quality.evidence: 0 settlement rows outside Q2; max settlement delta $0.000000; max PO delta $0.000000.
data_quality.resolution: Confirmed Q2 date scope and arithmetic tie-outs within floating-point tolerance.
data_quality.ongoing_control: Block reporting when date, row-count, or amount reconciliation tests exceed tolerance.
